rationale.intuition: Duke ED 17.33%; intl admit 3.86% (RD). Vietnamese intl pool is much smaller than CN/IN/KR, with less saturation — Duke specifically values geographic diversity from underrepresented sending countries (SEA pool). SAT 1480 below 25th-percentile (1500) → marginal. Public Policy (Sanford) is competitive but humanities differentiation helps. ED boost for SEA intl can be 2-3x RD intl rate. Industry: Duke ED SEA underrepresented strong cluster 5-22% per Crimson + Compass data — wider uncertainty band reflects smaller published sample.

sources.name: Duke CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit 5.71%; ED 17.33%; intl admit 3.86%. Geographic-diversity weight applies to underrepresented sending countries.

sources.name: Crimson Southeast Asia Acceptance Report 2024
sources.evidence: Vietnamese applicants at T15 ED cluster 5-20% in published case data; smaller pool yields higher per-applicant odds than saturated CN/IN bucket.

sources.name: NACAC State of College Admission 2024 — International Diversity
sources.evidence: T15 schools explicitly weight underrepresented sending countries (SEA, Africa, Latin America); per-country quota effects.
